name: aco-agents
description: ACO — Art & Commerce Office: a context-first multi-office agent framework for creative practice, organizations, agencies, product work, legal workflows, recruitment, and durable work history.

interface.shortDescription: A modular office of specialist AI workflows.
interface.longDescription: ACO routes natural-language requests across specialist offices for artistic practice, cultural organizations, creative agencies, product/software, legal workflows, and recruitment. It works without persistent memory by default, and can optionally use a user-connected Google Drive as a private knowledge and history layer. ACO never gains Drive access automatically: the user connects Google Drive separately and chooses the ACO folder to use.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Concierge. Tell me what you want to achieve. If persistent context would help, explain that I can optionally connect Google Drive and choose an ACO knowledge folder; otherwise continue without persistent memory.
